comments.text:
Really good song! I wanted to kinda leave my interpretation cause I keep looping and rewatching this:

Teto is a famous streamer, Miku is a fan that's obsessed with her to the point of parasocial love. She became a fan due to her loneliness and Teto always being there would comfort her. She sends her words of love in her chat but Teto doesn't smile at her words or react much to them so she decides to become famous herself to get close to her. 

After becoming frustrated with her own content not getting any attention she pivots to trying to get Teto's attention by showing her love for her and also trying to emulate her. She starts taking fan photos and posting them online to show her love like celebrating Teto's birthday. The posts go viral and she becomes famous online for it. However, she's famous for being a fan of Teto and no one see's her for herself so she continues to feel lonely and like there's no one there for her. 

She starts to see the negatives of being an online personality with people lying about her or being artificial towards her and Miku becomes addicted to scrolling through posts about her and Teto for validation. While having a breakdown over her feelings she watches another one of Teto's streams and she's reminded the reason she's doing this is out of an obsession to be with the person she loves. Her mental state gets worse and turns towards a weird hatred and love for Teto and a hatred for herself (the torn up Teto and Miku dolls, the day on her calendar once looking forward to Teto's birthday crossed out repeatedly) 

At the end she realizes Teto is the same as her and that's why Teto doesn't smile in her streams. They're both lonely and looking to fill the void through streaming and getting other peoples love, but seeing them not know who they really are and all the online attention of posts and haters just makes them more depressed. In the end she accepts how she is and continues to be a creator despite the pain of doing it weighing on her.

comments.text:
「孤独サイコ」（Psycho Mode）の歌詞の英語訳についてお話しします。この曲は、TAK/DORIDORIによって制作され、初音ミクがフィーチャーされています。歌詞は孤独感や心理的な葛藤をテーマにしており、非常に感情的な内容が特徴です。

歌詞の中では、孤独を感じながらもその感情を表現できないもどかしさや、他者とのつながりを求める気持ちが描かれています。例えば、「寂しくない」と言いながらも、実際には深い孤独を抱えているという矛盾した感情が表現されています。また、「孤独最高、だけどサイコ」というフレーズは、孤独を受け入れつつも、その状態が精神的に不安定であることを示唆しています。

英語訳の一部を紹介すると、以下のような内容になります：

１. 「So lonely, so lonely, a lonely Psycho」 - 孤独であることを強調するフレーズ。
２. 「I'm not really lonely」 - 孤独を否定する一方で、内面的な葛藤を示しています。
３. 「誰か気づいてくれよ」 - 誰かに自分の気持ちを理解してほしいという願望。

このように、歌詞は孤独感とその中での自己認識を深く掘り下げており、聴く人に強い共感を呼び起こします。曲全体を通して、孤独と向き合う姿勢や、そこから生まれる感情の複雑さが表現されています。

この曲は、現代の若者が抱える孤独感や社会との関係性を反映しており、多くのリスナーにとって共鳴するテーマとなっています。
